sloka: न्यास भूतम् इदम् राज्यम् तव निर्यातयामि अहम् ।मा च रोषम् कृथाः सौम्य मम शत्रु निषूदन॥४-१०-९॥
transliteration: nyāsa bhūtam idam rājyam tava niryātayāmi aham ।mā ca roṣam kṛthāḥ saumya mama śatru niṣūdana॥4-10-9॥

translations.english: 'I am handing over this kingdom which was in trust. O slayer of enemies, O good natured one, give up your anger against me.
